question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"in".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **In the given option, "**in**" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• **"In turn"** means **because of that.**
 
• Example: Stress causes your body to release chemicals, which** in turn** boost blood pressure.
 
• Thus, ***option 3) ***is the correct option.

Correct Paragraph:__ *When it (1) __comes__ to witnessing wars, famines or disease outbreaks on the news, guilt may (2) __inspire__ us to volunteer or donate money. Watching the generosity of other people (3) __who__ play an active role in helping others is also guilt-provoking, which can **(4) __in__** turn activate us to take similar (5)______ thus paying forward.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• We use "**in turn**" to refer to actions or events that are in a sequence one after the other, for example because one causes the other.

 
 
• **Example: ***Each member of the party,** in turn **stood to narrate their own story until everyone had spoken.*
